title.value: Generating Stable and Collision-Free Policies through Lyapunov Function Learning

title.quote: Generating Stable and Collision-Free Policies through Lyapunov Function Learning

extractions.description: The paper presents a novel method for learning a Lyapunov function and policy using a single neural network model, aimed at enhancing robot motion planning in dynamic environments. This method is equipped with an obstacle avoidance module that ensures collision-free policies for convex object pairs and demonstrates the capability of sim-to-real policy transfer. It further discusses improvements over existing methods by learning Lyapunov functions from demonstrations, providing stability guarantees, and integrating these into the neural network learning process.
